rows.rationale: Adds the universal BCNF dependency-loss witness (Abiteboul-Hull-Vianu Example 11.2.10): every BCNF decomposition of {AB -> C, C -> B} loses a dependency. No equivalent statement exists in formal-math yet. Appends worked examples for minimal covers and 3NF synthesis (non-minimal cover and superkey counterexamples, positive synthesis examples).

Appends worked examples for the six Expr query rewrites (select_comm, select_union, select_diff, project_union, select_project, select_join_right) on a three-relation schema; formal-math has no equivalents yet.
